{{Quote|This is Darkling Woods... It was here the heroes met the Demon King and with the Sacred Stones defeated him. I've heard the lingering energies of that battle are the source of the monsters.|[[Seth]]}}

'''Darkling Woods''' (Japanese: {{hl|闇の樹海|Yami no jukai}} ''Dark Forest'') is the twentieth chapter of {{FE8}}.

==Plot==
{{main|Darkling Woods/Script (Eirika)|Darkling Woods/Script (Ephraim)}}

[[Lyon]] approaches the temple in the heart of [[Darkling Woods (location)|Darkling Woods]], and encounters [[Morva]]. In Eirika's route, Morva instantly recognizes [[Fomortiis]], while Fomortiis taunts him by bringing up his daughter, [[Myrrh]], who is traveling to Darkling Woods. In Ephraim's route, Morva attempts to convince Lyon that the Demon King is in control and has changed him, but is unsuccessful. In both routes, Morva resolves to kill Lyon to prevent the return of the Demon King.

At the same time, the group nears the temple; they are put off by the Darkling Woods. Myrrh states that the state of the Woods has worsened; she also explains that she lived there guarding the temple with Morva, her foster father. Myrrh then begins to feel unwell as [[Seth]] informs the group that [[monster]]s are approaching them. Lyon, having killed Morva, reanimates his body, then leaves [[Riev]] to guard the temple. As the battle begins, Riev celebrates that the Demon King will soon return.

After the battle, once the temple is seized, the twins resolve to stop the ritual to resurrect the Demon King quickly. Myrrh, knowing Morva is dead, laments the death of her father. In Eirika's route, Eirika comforts Myrrh; Myrrh states that she met with her father and he cannot meet the group, though she does tell Eirika of how he has helped her—Myrrh then resolves to defeat the Demon King. Lyon then staggers into the temple, struggling through pain; Fomortiis taunts him about his weakness, and how Eirika will be crushed. In Ephraim's route, Ephraim comforts Myrrh; he deduces that the dragon they faced was Myrrh's father, and encourages Myrrh to not hide her emotions. As Lyon enters the temple, he reflects on the time when [[Vigarde]] died—leaving him with the duty to save [[Grado]] from a devastating earthquake—and when he decided to use Grado's [[Sacred Stone (object)|Sacred Stone]]. Lyon then readies himself for the resurrection of Fomortiis, sacrificing himself for the people of Grado.

====Reinforcements====
*For 3 turns after entering the northeastern region (columns 18–26, rows 1–14)
**2 [[Cyclops|Cyclopes]] from the northern cave
*After entering the southern region (columns 8–17, rows 16–21)
**2 [[Deathgoyle]]s with [[Steel Lance]]s from the southwestern cave
**1 [[Deathgoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] and a [[Javelin]] from the southwestern cave
***These reinforcements repeat each second turn for a total of four waves.
*After entering the northern region (columns 8–17, rows 1–7)
**1 [[Deathgoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] from the northwestern cave
**1 [[Deathgoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] and a [[Javelin]] from the northwestern cave
**1 [[Deathgoyle]] with an [[Axereaver]] from the northwestern cave
***These reinforcements repeat each second turn for a total of four waves.
*For 2 turns after entering the central region (columns 8–17, rows 8–15)
**3 [[Mogall]]s from outside the gate
***Three turns after the previous set, the first wave repeats each third turn for four waves.
*Turns 5–6 <small>(Difficult only)</small>
**1 [[Gargoyle]] with a [[Javelin]] and a [[Steel Lance]] from the northeastern cave
**1 [[Gargoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] and a [[Javelin]] from the northeastern cave
**1 [[Gargoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] from the northeastern cave
*Turns 16, 18, and 20
**1 [[Maelduin]] with a [[Steel Axe]] from right of the southwestern cave
**1 [[Maelduin]] with a [[Steel Bow]] from right of the southwestern cave
**1 [[Maelduin]] with a [[Steel Axe]] and a [[Hand Axe]] from right of the southwestern cave <small>(Difficult only)</small>
*Turns 17, 19, and 21
**2 [[Deathgoyle]]s with [[Steel Lance]]s from the central cave
**1 [[Deathgoyle]] with a [[Steel Lance]] and a [[Javelin]] from the central cave <small>(Difficult only)</small>
*Turns 20, 22, 24, 26, and 28
**2 <small>(Easy/Normal)</small>/3 <small>(Difficult)</small> [[Elder Bael]]s with [[Sharp Claw]]s from right of the western thickets
**1 [[Elder Bael]] with a [[Lethal Talon]] from right of the western thickets
**3 [[Gwyllgi]]s; one from right of the western thickets, one from right of the southwestern cave, and one from below the northwestern thickets <small>(Difficult only)</small>

==Strategy==
{{strategy}}
Before you begin, make sure you are well stocked on expendable, high durability, weapons ''and'' have ample room in the convoy for the plentiful drops. This chapter alone features over 100 enemies on Difficult, and you can not return to the world map before the following two. Having two [[Chest Key]]s will save you needing to deploy a thief on the next chapter. In addition, any unit you intend to use to fight [[Fomortiis]] should have 51 or higher physical bulk to survive his retaliation and 23 Speed to double him. [[Eirika]], [[Ephraim]], [[Seth]], and [[L'Arachel]] (with extreme grinding) all spawn in the final map close enough to attack Fomortiis on turn 1 without aid from [[Tethys]] or the [[Swiftsole]]; [[Vidofnir]] for Seth and [[Ivaldi]] for [[Valkyrie]] L'Arachel grant +5 Defense, while [[Excalibur]] for [[Mage Knight]] L'Arachel grants +5 Speed.

Most of the enemies are not difficult, and the layout is largely linear for non-flying units. As long as you don't advance too fast you have reinforcements spawn within your ranks, and the fliers are kept at bay the main level is more a test of endurance and not overextending. Even if you haven't trained her at all up to this point, [[Myrrh]] has plenty of opportunities to reach a high level in this chapter alone. Beware that Riev ''will'' move if a unit enters his range.

Morva is a hard boss on Difficult due to his weapon ignoring defense while, unlike the many [[Luna (tome)|Luna]] druids encountered so far, having the accuracy and power to make use of it. The only reliable defense is high HP, which few units actually have until high levels. Letting him attack first is essentially mandatory without relying on luck to carry the day. From here heal the unit, move the healer to safety with rescue/dance if not using a Physic, and keep counter attacking.

Provided Eirika/Ephraim is trained well enough, it may be possible to have a flying unit start next to them and carry them across the map for a speedy victory, dropping them in the patch of forest closest to Morva.

In Darkling Woods, I will perform a ceremony... Through this ceremony, I will gain immense power. Power to change not only Grado, but the entire world.|[[Lyon]] to [[Ephraim]]|The Sacred Stones}}</ref>
